purpose: Defines what a market hypothesis must demonstrate before it may become a strategy-design candidate. Contains no hypothesis, feature, threshold or result.

stop_rule.statement: Failure at any gate stops promotion for that candidate.
stop_rule.no_retry_by_redefinition: A failed gate may not be re-attempted by redefining feature, label, horizon, population or threshold on the same data. That is a new hypothesis and inherits the accumulated multiple-testing burden of every version attempted.
stop_rule.no_skipping: A gate may not be skipped because a later gate is considered more important.
stop_rule.inconclusive_is_not_a_pass: INCONCLUSIVE stops promotion exactly as NOT SUPPORTED does. The distinction is for institutional memory only.

production_status.implementation_issues: documented, NOT repaired (repair would alter the control)
production_status.must_not_be_used_as_a_comparison_benchma: Beating a control with no demonstrated edge establishes nothing.

gates.name: MARKET HYPOTHESIS
requires_before_computation: why the effect should survive transaction costs
gates.cardinal_rule: No hypothesis may be created merely because a feature/label combination produces a large statistic.
reject_if: any definition contains a parameter to be chosen later
required data or regimes absent from the dataset

gates.name: CAUSAL DEFINITION
gates.requirement: Explicit proof that feature information ends before label information begins.
mandatory_checks: prefix reconstruction test (deviation must be exactly 0.0)
gates.note: The prefix test does not substitute for the full-series-leakage check. A full-series computation can be causal and still be the wrong number. State which window each indicator uses and why the consumer will have that window.

mechanical_check.rule: The specification commit must contain no results file, analysis script or panel.

power_precheck.rule: If the declared expected effect is below the minimum detectable effect at its horizon, the test cannot inform the hypothesis and must not be run as though it could. Record UNTESTABLE instead.
power_precheck.null_interpretation: A null at 4h means 'no effect larger than about 0.26 ATR', not 'no effect'. That is above round-turn cost, so a tradable 4h effect can hide below this programme's 4h resolution.

gates.name: CORRECT STATISTICAL INFERENCE
must_report: block statistics as secondary diagnostics only
confidence interval and n on every cell
prohibited: unweighted block means as the headline estimator
unweighted block means as a tiebreak or overriding robustness check

estimator_sign_disagreement.on_flag: requires investigation and explanation BEFORE promotion
may_not: be resolved by preferring the more favourable estimator

two_sample_contrasts.problem: Pass and fail samples are each internally non-overlapping but their forward windows may overlap each other; measured up to 99.97%. The pooled SE then assumes an independence that does not hold.
required: report cross-group forward-window overlap per cell
re-estimate with a moving-block bootstrap, block length declared in advance
report both estimators; a sign disagreement between them means the effect is noise and must be reported as such

gates.name: MULTIPLE-TESTING CONTROL
must_report: observed exceedances at |t|>=2 and at the corrected threshold
expected null exceedances (0.0455 x declared count)
Bonferroni threshold computed from the declared count
gates.uncomputable_cells: Padded as non-rejections so m stays the declared count. Dropping them shrinks m and makes Benjamini-Hochberg more liberal.

gates.name: TEMPORAL REPLICATION
reject_if: the candidate exists only in one favourable period
the sign flips across pre-defined segments
gates.asymmetry: Permitted where the economic mechanism genuinely predicts it, documented in the pre-registration BEFORE results. An asymmetry found afterwards and explained as predicted is post-hoc rationalisation.
gates.drift_signature: Positive long and negative short in a direction-normalised metric is the signature of drift, not of the claimed mechanism.

gates.name: REGIME ROBUSTNESS

standing_dataset_limitation.consequence: A candidate whose mechanism depends on falling markets cannot be validated on this dataset and must be recorded as UNTESTABLE rather than tested in a proxy regime. Downtrend strips inside a rising market are not a bear regime.

gates.threshold_units: Thresholds must be scale-relative (ATR or equivalent), justified in the pre-registration. Absolute-dollar thresholds have era-dependent selectivity by construction.

gates.name: ECONOMIC / COST TEST
minimum_contents: slippage over a grid: 0, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0 x spread
expected net movement with confidence interval

cost_convention.formula: ask = mid + S/2, bid = mid - S/2
cost_convention.correction_note: Earlier reports stated 2 x spread. One spread, not two.

quintile_separation_is_not_expected_retu.statement: A Q5-Q1 spread of 0.10 ATR does not mean a rule earns 0.10 ATR. A rule trading Q5 earns mean(Q5) - cost, and mean(Q5) is typically a fraction of the separation; it may be negative while the separation is large, because the separation can be produced entirely by Q1.
quintile_separation_is_not_expected_retu.applies_equally_to: pass-vs-fail differences: a rule earns mean(pass) - cost, not mean(pass) - mean(fail)

gates.stop_rule: A candidate that does not survive gross economics stops here.

gates.name: EXECUTION REALISM
prohibited: using M1 or tick data to manufacture a directional edge
third-party data for execution or fill claims

availability_must_be_verified.sentinel_rule: A 1-row response from copy_rates_range is a sentinel for an unmaterialised period, not data.
availability_must_be_verified.monotonicity: Availability is not monotonic in lookback, so bisection over it is invalid. Use full year-by-year scans with expected-count validation.

clock.rule: Every timestamp in a report states its zone. Session logic is UTC-based.

gates.name: FINAL_OOS VALIDATION
unlock_requires_all: explicit written authorisation from the strategy architect
record of date, git SHA and candidate specification SHA at the moment of opening
gates.one_look_only: A revised candidate on a used OOS is a new candidate on a spent arm.

purge_embargo.rule: Dropped after each boundary so no forward window spans two arms. Panels are truncated at the arm boundary BEFORE any feature or label is computed, and the truncation is asserted.

gates.name: CONTROLLED STRATEGY DESIGN
gates.why_separately: Freezing them together allows a choice in one to be justified by an outcome in another.

optimisation_separated_from_validation.search_on: TRAIN only, with the search space declared in advance
optimisation_separated_from_validation.DEV: measures the chosen configuration; does not select it
optimisation_separated_from_validation.reselection_after_DEV: returns the candidate to G2 as a new pre-registration

prohibited_statements: any claim that a strategy choice is optimal
gates.insufficient_evidence: record UNRESOLVED or INCONCLUSIVE; do not force a classification
gates.four_historical_trades: Forensic illustration only. n=4. They support no statistic, no threshold and no selection.

gates.name: PAPER / SHADOW TEST
gates.definition: A frozen strategy runs against live market data WITHOUT placing orders, for a pre-declared duration with acceptance criteria set before the period begins.
gates.purpose: detect divergence between replay and live behaviour, not to re-estimate the edge
required: documented comparison of paper decisions against deterministic replay over the same period

gates.name: LIVE READINESS REVIEW
requirements: no lookahead (exhaustive window-mapping audit, not sampled)
broker execution validation against the actual broker
spread/slippage validation matching the G7 assumptions
logging sufficient to reconstruct any decision after the fact
gates.note: Nothing in G11 or G12 authorises changing the live-trading safety invariant. Relaxing it is a separate decision with its own authorisation.

phases.outcome: Phase 1 headline RETRACTED; estimator failure identified and fixed

phases.note: Both confirmation layers subtract from bias alone at every horizon. Bias alone INCONCLUSIVE.

phases.outcome: NO PREDEFINED PRODUCTION LAYER DEMONSTRATES ROBUST INCREMENTAL INFORMATION

implementation_issues_documented_not_rep.evidence: poi_score takes 9 distinct values across 60,638 decisions and equals exactly 68.0 on 89.44%. Threshold is 60 with a confirmed sweep and 70 without, and 68 lies between, so on those bars L6's verdict is 100% determined by L5's. Overall agreement 94.38%.
get_h1_structure takes the bias as input; 0 contradicting classifications in 60,638 sided decisions. 'Confirmed' means only 'not BROKEN and not UNKNOWN', true of 81.22%.

h1_atr is a 14-bar mean of high-low in dollars, not a Wilder ATR, on an instrument that went from ~1,800 to ~4,600. Passed 6.19% of TRAIN but 41.90% of DEV sided decisions, and blocked 0 of 15,735 in the 2026 run.

implementation_issues_documented_not_rep.issue: historical trades used a bypassed micro-scalp path
implementation_issues_documented_not_rep.evidence: All four baseline_008 signals were MICRO_SCALP MOMENTUM entries on one identical path with L3 and L6 bypassed by regime flags: six of eight layers evaluated. The documented eight-layer path has never produced a trade.

implementation_issues_documented_not_rep.issue: production EMA initialisation differs from full-series EMA research
implementation_issues_documented_not_rep.evidence: Production passes 60 H1 bars so ema_50 is SMA-seeded and advanced ten steps. Full-series research differs on 13.0% of bias labels (one outright sign flip) and 83.5% of bias strengths, median |diff| 0.608 on a 0-10 scale.

detect_choch is not a textbook CHoCH implementation; breaker-block construction is not present despite being referenced; sweep implementation and documentation disagree; rr == tp_ratio is a tautology; the L2 BOS flip can change side after L1 sets it; compute_cvd_proxy reads tick.last and tick.volume, both 0% populated; layer_funnel.json merges L5_SWEEP (3,064) with L5_SWEEP_WAIT (1,936) into one bucket of 5,000; all four trades record confidence = 0.0 while graded 'A'.
